# SweepX

> Unified Linux Application Tracker, Live Installation Watcher, and Deep Residual Uninstaller in pure Rust (Iced GUI).

SweepX provides a unified inventory of software across native packaging formats (Debian and Ubuntu dpkg, Arch Linux pacman, Fedora and RHEL rpm), containerized packaging runtimes (Flatpak, Snap), standalone AppImages, and manual installations in `/opt` or user `$PATH` directories (such as `~/.local/bin`, `~/.pixi/bin`, `~/.cargo/bin`).

It includes an installation watcher that records filesystem changes during source builds (`make install`), a residual cleaner that inspects XDG directories and user systemd files, and a safety barrier that prevents deletion of system paths.

## Core Capabilities

- **Unified Multi-Format Discovery:** Scans dpkg, pacman, rpm, flatpak, snap, AppImages, /opt, and user $PATH without background daemon overhead.
- **Real-Time Install Watcher:** Wraps source builds (`make install`, custom install scripts) to capture filesystem diffs and store exact deletion manifests.
- **Deep Residual Purge:** Discovers leftover configuration files (`~/.config`), cache trees (`~/.cache`), local application data (`~/.local/share`), broken symlinks, and user systemd services.
- **Safety Barrier:** Validates paths to prevent removal of root (`/`), user home roots (`/home/$USER`), `/usr`, `/etc`, `/var`, and active shell configurations.
- **Dual Interface:** Runs as a desktop GUI (`Iced 0.13`) with a GiB/GB storage unit toggle, or as a standalone CLI with JSON output.
- **In-Place Self-Updater:** Checks GitHub Releases and atomically swaps the running executable binary without requiring external package managers.

## Quick Installation

### Universal 1-Line Installer (Bash)
```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haydermuhib/SweepX/main/install.sh | bash
```

### Build from Source (Cargo)
```bash
git clone https://github.com/haydermuhib/SweepX.git
cd SweepX
cargo build --release
# Executable binary located at target/release/sweepx
```

## CLI Subcommand Reference

- `sweepx`: Launches the graphical desktop interface.
- `sweepx list [--filter <native|flatpak|snap|appimage|manual>] [--json]`: Lists all installed software across all packaging layers.
- `sweepx inspect <app_id_or_name>`: Inspects binary paths, desktop entry files, associated systemd units, and XDG cache/config footprints.
- `sweepx clean <app_id_or_name> [--dry-run] [--permanent] [--yes]`: Scans and removes leftover residual directories and caches for a specific app.
- `sweepx purge <app_id_or_name> [--dry-run] [--permanent] [--yes]`: Uninstalls unmanaged software (/opt or AppImage) and purges all related artifacts.
- `sweepx sweep [--dry-run] [--json]`: Cleans system-wide bloat including disabled Snap revisions, unused Flatpak runtimes, and package manager caches.
- `sweepx watch --name <app_name> -- <command>`: Tracks an installation command (e.g. `sudo make install`) and records an exact deletion manifest.
- `sweepx history`: Displays audit logs and total lifetime disk space reclaimed.
- `sweepx update [--check]`: Checks GitHub for newer releases and performs atomic self-update.

## System Architecture

- `src/scanner/`: Multi-tier scanners (Native PM, Flatpak, Snap, AppImage, Manual /opt).
- `src/tracker/`: Filesystem snapshot engine and install watcher manifest generator.
- `src/cleaner/`: Safety barrier validator, symlink graph resolver, and atomic deletion engine.
- `src/db/`: Embedded SQLite storage for manifests, residual signatures, and audit logs.
- `src/ui/`: Reactive hardware-accelerated desktop interface built with Iced 0.13 and custom Burgundy/Cream/Pistachio theme.
- `src/cli/`: Terminal command parser and automation handlers.
- `src/updater/`: GitHub Releases client and in-place binary updater.
